title: A Discrete 3d-4f Metallacage as an Efficient Catalytic Nanoreactor for a Three-Component Aza-Darzens Reaction

synthesis.procedure: H5L (23.6 mg, 0.05 mmol) and triethylamine (16 μL, 0.22 mmol) were stirred in methanol (2 mL) for 15 min to give a transparent yellow solution. ZnCl2 (6.8 mg, 0.05 mmol) in methanol (4 mL) was added dropwise and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 10 min to give a suspension. Er(NO3)3·5H2O (22.2 mg, 0.05 mmol) in methanol (2 mL) was then added, affording a clear solution. After 1 week, yellow lump crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were filtered, washed three times with cold methanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.time: stirring 15 min then 10 min; crystallization 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly in methanol followed by standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow lump crystals filtered after 1 week, washed three times with cold methanol, and dried in air
synthesis.yield: 49.0% (24.3% based on oxalyl chloride monoethyl ester)

properties.summary: The solid Zn2Er4 cage shows characteristic Er3+ NIR emission used to confirm catalyst integrity before and after the aza-Darzens reaction; recycled catalyst spectra were unchanged.

measurements.name: NIR emission (Er3+ 4I13/2 → 4I15/2)
measurements.conditions: solid state, excitation/emission spectra before and after the three-component aza-Darzens reaction
